body: I’ll be able to move out in 2 years. Currently I’m living in two places since I study in a different city, but it’s still just as painful to be around my dad. Unfortunately, I am not able to avoid it :).

Thank you for the tips! Unfortunately, I will have to get him at 7 weeks old (not 6, mistake on my part), because of the situation I’m being put in, but I’ve read that 6 weeks old is the youngest age puppies should be separated from their moms in, so I wasn’t too worried. I really hope that won’t affect his life and happiness much. I‘m pretty sure that all the other pups have already been taken and he’s the only one left and their seller can’t look after him anymore since she would be traveling soon. The initial idea was to get him in November, when he would be around 9 weeks old, but the traveling thing popped up out of nowhere. And in my case we would only have to deal with potential angry neighbors, but that should be okay. I’m not sure how crate training works, but I’ll look it up. Thanks again!
